reports.label: Evidence arriving from different sources
reports.description: A patient report and console indications both reach the investigation. The investigation compares possible explanations. The diagram makes no claim that either observation identifies a source defect.
reports.caption: An observation constrains an explanation; it does not select one automatically. These are evidence roles, not machine components.
reports.source:
@startuml
layout vertical
component PatientReport
component ConsoleIndications
component Investigation
component Explanations
PatientReport --> Investigation : unexpected effect
ConsoleIndications --> Investigation : message and reading
Investigation --> Explanations : compare with evidence
@enduml

machine.label: One request, several configuration responsibilities
machine.description: Prescription entry influences beam setup and positioning separately. Beam setup determines operating parameters; positioning determines the beam path. Both affect output. These are conceptual responsibilities, not recovered software modules.
machine.caption: A displayed request and an applied configuration answer different questions.
machine.source:
@startuml
layout vertical
component Prescription
component BeamSetup
component Positioning
component Output
Prescription --> BeamSetup : select parameters
Prescription --> Positioning : select arrangement
BeamSetup --> Output : operating parameters
Positioning --> Output : beam path
@enduml

histories.label: Two histories with the same final request
histories.description: In one history an electron request is entered directly. In the other an X-ray request is entered, setup begins, and the request is corrected to electron mode while setup is outstanding. Neither resulting output is shown.
histories.caption: A comparison experiment must specify more than the last value on screen. These are teaching scenarios.
histories.source:
@startuml
actor operator: Operator
participant input: Request
participant setup: Setup work
alt [direct entry]
  operator -> input: enter E
  setup -> input: read request
  input --> setup: E
else [correction during setup]
  operator -> input: enter X
  setup -> input: read request
  input --> setup: X
  operator -> input: correct to E
end
note over input: Final request is E
@enduml

before_second_read.label: Pause before the positioning read
before_second_read.description: The request is X when beam setup selects parameters. The operator then edits the request to E. Positioning has not yet performed the read shown next in this reconstruction.
before_second_read.caption: Read downward. Each lane represents a responsibility; a memory read is drawn as an exchange for explanation.
before_second_read.source:
@startuml
actor operator: Operator
participant request: Shared request
participant beam: Beam setup
participant position: Positioning
operator -> request: enter X
beam -> request: read mode
request --> beam: X
beam -> beam: select X parameters
operator -> request: correct to E
note over position: Next read not yet shown
@enduml

different_reads.label: Decisions derived from different requests
different_reads.description: Beam setup derives parameters from X before the correction. Positioning reads E afterward and selects the E arrangement. No automatic reconciliation or permission to operate is shown.
different_reads.caption: Reconstructed ordering: each decision depends on the value read at that time.
different_reads.source:
@startuml
actor operator: Operator
participant request: Shared request
participant beam: Beam setup
participant position: Positioning
operator -> request: enter X
beam -> request: read mode
request --> beam: X
beam -> beam: select X parameters
operator -> request: correct to E
position -> request: read mode
request --> position: E
position -> position: select E arrangement
note over beam: Earlier parameters retained
@enduml

flag_question.label: A flag changes while its protected work continues
flag_question.description: Magnet setup begins. Its first delay check clears the magnet-setting flag. An input correction then occurs while setup continues. The result of a later conditional edit check has not yet been shown.
flag_question.caption: Reconstructed control flow. Clearing a flag sets it to off; it does not undo the input correction.
flag_question.source:
@startuml
participant setup: Magnet setup
participant delay: Delay checks
participant flags: Shared state
setup -> flags: setting flag on
setup -> delay: first delay
delay -> flags: clear setting flag
note over setup: Setup continues
note over flags: Request corrected to E
setup -> delay: later delay
note over delay: Edit check requires flag on
@enduml

flag_result.label: Why a correction can escape reconciliation
flag_result.description: The first delay call clears the setting flag. A later correction changes the request. A later delay invocation reads the cleared flag and skips its edit check, allowing earlier parameters to remain. The figure omits the separate setup-completion weakness and unrelated instructions.
flag_result.caption: Reconstructed control flow: the later edit check requires a flag that is already off.
flag_result.source:
@startuml
participant setup: Magnet setup
participant delay: Delay checks
participant flags: Shared state
setup -> flags: setting flag on
setup -> delay: first delay
delay -> flags: clear setting flag
note over flags: Request corrected to E
setup -> delay: later delay
delay -> flags: read setting flag
flags --> delay: off
delay -> delay: skip edit check
note over setup: Earlier parameters retained
@enduml

repair_question.label: What should authorize readiness?
repair_question.description: The proposed model starts inhibited, begins preparation, and has an unfinished condition on the transition to ready. Editing from ready returns to inhibited. The missing condition is the learner's design decision.
repair_question.caption: Proposed teaching contract, not the original Therac phase machine. The guard is deliberately unfinished.
repair_question.source:
@startuml
layout portrait
state Inhibited
state Preparing
state Ready
[*] --> Inhibited
Inhibited --> Preparing : begin setup
Preparing --> Ready : complete [which condition?]
Ready --> Inhibited : edit / revoke permission
@enduml

repair.label: A proposed authorization contract
repair.description: Inhibited starts preparation for a request. Only a current consistent completion reaches Ready. Obsolete completion preserves preparation. Editing in Preparing or Ready inhibits operation. The outer box groups those two states under the shared edit rule. This is a partial teaching specification.
repair.caption: Proposed teaching model. A guard is in brackets; an action follows a slash.
repair.source:
@startuml
layout portrait
state Inhibited
state SetupLifecycle {
  state Preparing
  state Ready
  Preparing --> Ready : complete [current and consistent] / authorize
  Preparing --> Preparing : complete [obsolete] / discard
  Ready --> Ready : operate [consistent] / accept
}
[*] --> Inhibited
Inhibited --> Preparing : begin setup / capture request
SetupLifecycle --> Inhibited : edit / invalidate
@enduml

yakima_question.label: A required check meets a byte boundary
yakima_question.description: Repeated setup passes have brought the check-required value to 255. The next pass increments it. The result is left unknown. Limits checking uses a nonzero value to decide whether to call the position check.
yakima_question.caption: Reconstructed check rule. Setup-loop passes are not patient counts.
yakima_question.source:
@startuml
participant setup: Setup passes
participant flag: Check required
participant limits: Limits checking
participant check: Position check
note over flag: Value before increment is 255
setup -> flag: increment one byte
note over flag: New value?
limits -> flag: read value
opt [value is nonzero]
  limits -> check: check position
end
@enduml

yakima_result.label: The skipped check and the later decision
yakima_result.description: A setup increment wraps the check-required value to zero. Limits checking reads zero and skips the position check. In the representative vulnerable schedule, the turntable remains in field-light position, all blocking malfunction bits remain clear, SET occurs in the zero interval, and setup advances to phase 2. Skipping the call does not clear an already-set bit.
yakima_result.caption: Reconstructed path: field-light position, a positioning request during zero, and clear blocking status must coincide.
yakima_result.source:
@startuml
participant setup: Setup passes
participant flag: Check required
participant limits: Limits checking
participant status: Blocking status
note over setup: Turntable remains in field-light position
note over status: All blocking bits remain clear
setup -> flag: increment 255 to 0
limits -> flag: read value
flag --> limits: zero
limits -> limits: skip position check
note over setup: Request treatment position during zero
setup -> status: read status
status --> setup: zero
setup -> setup: advance setup
@enduml

layers.label: A control decision and a separate protective decision
layers.description: A controller requests output. A protective function uses configuration evidence to inhibit output. This conceptual architecture illustrates a distinct enforcement responsibility; drawing separate boxes does not establish real independence.
layers.caption: Independence is a property to demonstrate through implementation and evidence, not a consequence of diagram layout.
layers.source:
@startuml
layout vertical
component Controller
component ConfigurationEvidence
component Protection
component Output
Controller --> Output : requests operation
ConfigurationEvidence --> Protection : observed configuration
Protection --> Output : may inhibit
@enduml

transfer.label: A new investigation at a printer boundary
transfer.description: An interface first requests one copy, a worker begins preparing a job, and the interface changes to two copies. The worker submits a job to a printer, which produces one copy. The submitted copy count is deliberately unknown.
transfer.caption: Teaching scenario. Locate an observation that separates two explanations before choosing a repair.
transfer.source:
@startuml
participant ui: Print interface
participant worker: Job preparation
participant printer: Printer
ui -> worker: request one copy
worker -> worker: begin preparation
note over ui: Request changed to two copies
worker -> printer: submit job (count unknown)
printer --> ui: one copy produced
@enduml

system_overview.label: From treatment request to physical output
system_overview.description: A therapist enters a prescribed treatment through the console. The controller configures the treatment head. The head delivers radiation to the patient when operation is authorized. Arrows distinguish information from physical radiation; they do not show an accident.
system_overview.caption: System overview. The console is the interface; the treatment head produces the physical output.
system_overview.source:
@startuml
layout portrait
component Therapist
component Console
component Controller
component TreatmentHead
component Patient
Therapist --> Console : enter prescribed treatment
Console --> Controller : treatment request
Controller --> TreatmentHead : settings and positioning
TreatmentHead --> Patient : radiation during treatment
@enduml

electron_mode.label: Electron treatment: a spread electron beam
electron_mode.description: The accelerator produces an electron beam at settings appropriate to electron treatment. A spreading system distributes the beam across the treatment field. This conceptual path omits monitoring and other hardware.
electron_mode.caption: E means electron treatment. This simplified beam path omits hardware not needed for the comparison.
electron_mode.source:
@startuml
layout portrait
component Accelerator
component BeamSpreading
component TreatmentField
Accelerator --> BeamSpreading : electron treatment beam
BeamSpreading --> TreatmentField : spread electrons
@enduml

xray_mode.label: X-ray treatment: electrons strike a metal target
xray_mode.description: A substantially more intense electron beam strikes a metal target inside the treatment head. The target produces X-rays for treatment. Beam shaping and monitoring are omitted. The target is a machine component, not the tumor.
xray_mode.caption: X means X-ray treatment. The metal target is inside the machine, not inside the patient.
xray_mode.source:
@startuml
layout portrait
component Accelerator
component MetalTarget
component TreatmentField
Accelerator --> MetalTarget : high intensity electrons
MetalTarget --> TreatmentField : X rays
@enduml

normal_setup.label: A successful setup with one unchanged request
normal_setup.description: The operator requests electron treatment. The controller asks beam setup and positioning to prepare that mode. Both report completion. The diagram stops at the obligation to check the current configuration before permission; no radiation is shown. It illustrates intended relationships, not recovered software calls.
normal_setup.caption: Worked baseline: one unchanged request. Setup is preparation; it is not radiation delivery.
normal_setup.source:
@startuml
actor operator: Therapist
participant control: Controller
participant beam: Beam setup
participant position: Positioning
operator -> control: request E
control -> beam: prepare E settings
beam --> control: settings complete
control -> position: prepare E arrangement
position --> control: positioning complete
note over control: Check current configuration before permission
@enduml

yakima_normal.label: The intended position-checking chain
yakima_normal.description: A setup pass requests a position check by leaving a flag nonzero. The checker reads physical position and records a blocking problem if the arrangement is unsuitable. Progression consults that recorded status. This shows the intended dependency, not a complete instruction trace.
yakima_normal.caption: Worked baseline: requesting a check, performing it, and using its result are three separate steps.
yakima_normal.source:
@startuml
participant setup: Setup work
participant flag: Check required
participant check: Position check
participant status: Blocking status
setup -> flag: request check (nonzero)
check -> flag: read request
flag --> check: nonzero
check -> check: inspect physical position
opt [position unsuitable]
check -> status: record blocking problem
end
setup -> status: inspect result before progressing
@enduml
